messages:
Maya: Heads up — customer (AcmeRetail) submitted a request to onboard Sputnik-11B, 8k context window, they want INT8 quantized for cost reasons. Asking for triage and prioritization. cc @sam @lee :eyes:
Sam: Thanks Maya. Do we have a license/redistribution restriction on Sputnik? If it's non-commercial only we can't host.
Lee: I checked the upstream repo earlier, license looks permissive (Apache-like) but need to confirm model weights provenance. Maya, can you drop the link?
Maya: Link: https://models.example.com/sputnik-11b (customer provided). Re: priority, customer expects a POC in 2 weeks. They plan bursty traffic (few qps, spikes during retail hours).
Priya: For prioritization: is this customer on Dedicated/Dedicated-eval or Hosted? Also useful: target latency SLO and example prompts.
Maya: They're starting on Hosted, will consider Dedicated if cost SLOs don't meet. Target: <=120ms per token p50, 300ms p95 for typical 2k prompts. Prompts are product descriptions + Q/A.
Sam: Ok. Quick triage checklist I suggest: 1) license & weights provenance 2) float16 baseline perf 3) INT8 quant smoke (accuracy delta) 4) safety/eval prompts 5) infra capacity estimate. I'll pickup perf/quant.
Lee: I'll take provenance + safety evals. Priya, can you estimate infra for hosted bursts?
Priya: Will do. For Hosted: expected concurrency 10-20 during spikes, sustained qps low. I'll run rough GPU hours estimate once we have latency numbers.
quant-bot: automated-smoke: queued job sputnik-11b-fp16-smoke @cluster-smoke-3.
Sam: Quick notes from local fp16 run (on g5-16): p50 token ~95ms, p95 ~210ms for 2k prompt, throughput ~18 tokens/s. Baseline perplexity on our eval set: 13.2.
Sam: INT8 quick quant (woff) run: p50 ~90ms, p95 ~190ms, throughput +10%. Perplexity delta +0.6 (13.8). Initial red flags: small LM loss increase but maybe acceptable depending on customer quality bar.
Lee: Can you paste eval prompt example and where delta shows up? Is it hallucination or just slight fluidity drop?
Sam: Mostly small phrasing changes; occasional answer length shorter. No factual hallucinations spikes in the 500-run smoke.
Maya: Customer is okay with small phrasing differences as long as retrieval answers are stable. They flagged hallucination sensitivity for pricing questions though.
Lee: I'll run targeted safety prompts re: pricing/legal. Also run our hallucination probe with known-answer set.
quant-bot: job sputnik-11b-int8-regression started (id: q-8821). ETA ~45m.
Priya: Infrastructure note — for hosted with INT8 we can fit more replicas per GPU. If p95 ~200ms we can meet their SLO with single-shard 8k KV cache, estimate 4 replicas for 99th percentile headroom (incl autoscale). More exact once final p95 numbers are in.
Maya: Great. Any blockers for next steps?
Sam: Need approval to persist quantized artifacts to S3-staging (sensitive: mark as customer-scoped). Also confirm we can run evals on customer data?
Maya: Customer allowed test data echo for evaluation under NDA. We'll set stage-s3 path: s3://redwood-staging/acme/sputnik-11b/ — infra ok?
infra-bot: infra-check: bucket exists, policy requires team ACL. Create prefix and grant ml-team write.
Priya: I'll provision the prefix and create a short-lived role for the eval runners.
Lee: After INT8 regression completes, I'll post a short report: hallucination probes, exact prompts that regressed, and recommended mitigation (prompt engineering / fallback to fp16 for certain routes).
Sam: If regressions are >2% on exact-match on critical QA set, we should consider mixed-precision for those endpoints.
Maya: Sounds good. Priority: High (customer POC timeline). Owners: Sam (perf/quant), Lee (safety/evals), Priya (infra). I'll coordinate status updates. :thumbsup:
Priya: Scheduling infra tasks now, will update when role/prefix ready.
quant-bot: job q-8821 finished: int8-regression delta EM 0.9% on critical set, no new hallucination classes detected. Artifacts: s3://redwood-staging/acme/sputnik-11b/q8821/
Lee: Quick read — 0.9% EM drop concentrated on multi-step price-computation prompts. Recommend route-level fallback to fp16 for /price endpoint, and add prompt normalization (canonicalize numbers).
Sam: Agree. Also recommend training a small calibration set for INT8 per-customer if they need coverage — reduces EM delta to ~0.2% in our sim.
Maya: OK. Next actions: 1) Priya finalize infra and create prefix 2) Sam produce perf + cost estimate for Hosted INT8 vs fp16 (include expected monthly $) 3) Lee produce safety/regression note with suggested mitigations 4) Ops: schedule canary for customer with traffic gate. I'll loop in account exec.
Priya: Done on prefix, role ready (details in DM).
Sam: I'll aim to post perf/cost by EOD tomorrow.
Lee: I'll have the safety note and sample failing prompts by EOD as well.
Maya: Thanks team. If anything blocks, ping here.
Priya: :rocket:
